Ad one is a list format: three reasons I switched to cold brew, number one, no more two p.m. crash. Lists keep people watching to the end.

First, why this matters. UGC means user-generated content: a normal-looking person, holding a phone, talking about a product.
Those ads usually win on social feeds, but every one of them costs a creator, a shoot, and a few days of waiting.
